نستنهض (form X)
# نَسْتَنْهِضُ (nastanhiḍu) /nas.tan.hi.dˤu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِسْتَنْهَضَ (istanhaḍa)
# نَسْتَنْهِضَ (nastanhiḍa) /nas.tan.hi.dˤa/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِسْتَنْهَضَ (istanhaḍa)
# نَسْتَنْهِضْ (nastanhiḍ) /nas.tan.hidˤ/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of اِسْتَنْهَضَ (istanhaḍa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
